issue.title: validation failed comes back with empty details for a misspelt field
issue.body:
A typo in our client sent `PATCH /api/v1/reports/:id` with `"categroies"`
instead of `"categories"`. The response was

    400 {"error":"validation failed","details":{}}

so nothing said which field was wrong, and it took us an hour to spot. When we
send a known field with the wrong type, `details` names it, for example
`{"name":["Expected string, received number"]}`. `PATCH /users/me` with an
unknown field gives the same empty `details`.

input.title: Include unknown-field errors in validation failed details
input.body:
File: src/api/errors.ts

In errorHandler, the ZodError branch returns only err.flatten().fieldErrors. Zod reports unrecognized keys on a strict object as an issue with an empty path, so flatten() puts it in formErrors and fieldErrors stays empty. Change the branch to also surface those issues: for example, report each unrecognized_keys issue under its offending key names, or include formErrors in details, so a misspelt field such as "categroies" is named in the 400 response.
